option_relations.rationale: Central Retinal Vein Occlusion (CRVO) is a specific type of retinal vein occlusion, which is related to the leaf disease Central Retinal Vein Occlusion
Macular retinal vein occlusion with chronic cystoid macular edema is a condition that can manifest with cystoid macular edema, which is the leaf disease
Branch Retinal Vein Occlusion (BRVO) is a type of retinal vein occlusion, but it is not as directly related to the leaf disease Central Retinal Vein Occlusion as CRVO
Retinal vein occlusion is a broader class that contains the leaf disease Central Retinal Vein Occlusion
